lines.zh: 我的动作不连贯，像跳帧。
lines.en: My movements jump, like dropped frames.
I pause a long time between steps.

lines.zh: 地板没有响，可我已经近了一步。
lines.en: The floor made no sound, yet I am a step closer.
My outline shudders in the dark.

lines.zh: 我走的时候，墙上的影子先到。
lines.en: As I walk, my shadow on the wall arrives first.
I move along the edge of your vision.
The closer I get, the dimmer the light.
The air cools as I pass.
I stand with my head tilted.
I haven't moved in a long while.
I'm at the edge of your field of view.
My shadow on the wall is larger than me.
Sometimes my shape is wrong.
I'm counting how often you look back.
The light flickers; I'm still here.
I hold the same angle.
I'm patient. More patient than you.
There's no other sound in the room.
I've been there all along.
I stay motionless, like a still image.
I'm waiting for you to close your eyes.
You've seen me.
Now don't look away.
When you look back, I'm a little closer.

lines.zh: 我只是个被摆着的样子。
lines.en: I am only a display, placed here.
How many times have you counted?

lines.zh: 我的位置没有变，是你的位置在变。
lines.en: My place hasn't changed; yours has.
You look good standing like that.
You shouldn't have turned around.
Is there anything you'd like to say?
We're much too close.

lines.zh: 你的影子开始不像你的。
lines.en: Your shadow no longer looks like yours.

lines.zh: 你已经站在这里很久了。
lines.en: You've been standing here a long while.
I want you to watch me.

lines.zh: 这张脸被打散了，又慢慢拼回来。
lines.en: My face scatters, then slowly reassembles.

lines.zh: 这一下让我退回了墙上。
lines.en: That pushed me back into the wall.
A gap has opened in my outline.
I've lost a stretch of movement.
I stand there without answering.
This body isn't real.
I've grown fainter.

lines.zh: 你没有伤到我，只是打散了。
lines.en: You didn't hurt me; you only scattered me.
I'll show up again.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我只看着你的眼睛。
lines.en: You hold out food; I only watch your eyes.
You're talking to a shadow.
Put it down, then don't look.
I don't need that.
Put it away and look at me.
What are you trying to trade food for?
Hold it up longer; it won't help.
I'm not hungry; I'm only waiting.
You stepped back; I didn't.
You touched me. Cold, isn't it?
My edge brushed past you.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离没有了。
lines.en: There's no distance left between us.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的时候，我在笑。
lines.en: I was smiling when you stumbled into me.

lines.zh: 这一下你没有感觉重量。
lines.en: You didn't feel any weight.
I withdraw, then return to the spot.
I'm right behind you.

lines.zh: 我们贴得太近，看不见了。
lines.en: Too close to see anything now.

lines.zh: 第一阶段的影子，薄得像纸。
lines.en: In my first phase, my shadow is paper thin.
There's another one by the wall.

lines.zh: 我们看起来一样，其实不一样。
lines.en: We look alike; we aren't.
It's nearer the door than I am.
We never look at each other.

lines.zh: 我们站在同一个屋里，各占一边。
lines.en: We share this room, one side each.
Its face is less clear than mine.

lines.zh: 我们是同一张图的两个版本。
lines.en: We're two versions of the same picture.
When the light changed, it was gone.
Neither of us is the shadow.
We both wait through the night.
I have no hands to take anything with.
I can see what's on the floor.

lines.zh: 我不用捡，它自己会过来。
lines.en: I don't pick things up; they come to me.
Nothing in this room has gone missing.
I watch it roll into the corner.
I didn't leave that.
I don't touch anything.
I've counted everything on the floor.
It's still where it was.

lines.zh: 没有人的时候，它们都动过。
lines.en: When no one's here, they all move.
Now you're on my side.
I've turned my head straight.
There's less light now.
Go ahead and look back.
I'm at the far end of your retreat.

lines.zh: 这房间没有第二个出口。
lines.en: This room has no second exit.

lines.zh: 你屏住呼吸，可我还是听见了。
lines.en: You hold your breath. I hear it anyway.

lines.zh: 你身后有一块地方更黑。
lines.en: There's a patch behind you that's darker.
This step took me a long time.

lines.zh: 你一睁眼，我就站在灯下面。
lines.en: You open your eyes and I am under the lamp.
Don't look away.
I'm only a picture that moves.
I'm beside you.
I've finished counting. This is it.
You're in my picture now.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头，我的轮廓随你移动。
lines.en: At the hall's end, my outline moves with you.
I'm in the corner of your eye.
In the mirror I'm slower than the real one.

lines.zh: 隔着半条走廊，我就够得着你。
lines.en: Half a corridor away, I can already reach you.
When you look back, I give half a step.
You've been counting the whole way.
Your shadow isn't quite right.

lines.zh: 你越跑越快，我的影子没离开过。
lines.en: You run faster; my shadow never leaves you.
You can hear your own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 门在你那边，我在这一边。
lines.en: The door is your side; I'm on this one.
The corridor is longer than I remember.
I'm always just outside the frame.
You look worn out.
I don't need to rest.
Your turns are getting slower.
Just a moment longer.
I reach out, and I can't see my hand.

lines.zh: 你被推了一下，没有来源。
lines.en: Something shoves you; there's no source.

lines.zh: 这一下不在你的记忆里。
lines.en: That didn't go into your memory.
Some frames of my movement are missing.
There's no wound on you.
You tremble when I touch you.
No one saw that.
I withdraw, and I'm not where I was.
You heard something.

lines.zh: 我不用力气也能碰到你。
lines.en: I can reach you without strength.
That one will stay with you.
Shutting your eyes will not save you this time.
My shadow doesn't move with me.
You're in my picture.
I appeared in the doorway.

lines.zh: 这间屋里多了一个影子。
lines.en: There's an extra shadow in this room.

lines.zh: 我就是那张图里的东西。
lines.en: I'm the thing from that picture.
I only take shape when the light dims.
I begin from one side of the wall.
What number had you reached?
I settle, my face toward you.
My eyes have been open the whole time.
Listen — there's nothing at all.

lines.zh: 我又出现在你的视野里。
lines.en: I'm in your sight again.
I've turned my face your way.
There's a shadow on the wall behind you.

lines.zh: 这就是第一阶段的开始。
lines.en: This is how the first phase begins.
The light will come on one more time.
I'm waiting for that second.

lines.zh: 火光里，我的影子分裂了。
lines.en: In the firelight my shadow splits.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，落地没有声音。
lines.en: I fall and land without a sound.

lines.zh: 水淹过我，我变得更模糊。
lines.en: Water passes through me and I blur.
The flash scatters me.

lines.zh: 一个东西穿过了我，没有停。
lines.en: Something went through me and didn't stop.
Light pins me to the wall.
I have never been hungry.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮整间屋，我却更暗了。
lines.en: The flash lights the room, and I grow darker.
There is no sound here, and no echo.
